snippet.title: Happy's Humble Burger Cult - Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Happy's Humble Burger Cult (formerly known as Happy's Humble BURGATORY) is available now on Steam. Watch the Happy's Humble Burger Cult launch trailer for this co-op horror cooking game for 1-4 players. 

In this successor to Happy's Humble Burger Farm, get your friends together for your next terrifying game night: grill burgers, serve customers, and hit your quota before the kitchen turns into a nightmare. Escape Asset Joy's hunt alive and extract with your hard-earned cash to survive another shift. With dozens of game-changing modifiers and systems that react to how you speak (and misspeak) on mic, every shift is a fresh hell waiting to unravel.
